findings.finding: Container descriptor metadata is not required to agree across pages or between a parent child row and the follow-up selection. _collect validates selected_kind and child_count only from the last page; earlier page child_count/kind values are ignored. For nested containers, project checks the parent row kind but ignores that row's child_count and does not compare it with the selected-container child_count.
findings.impact: Responses with the same file/index/archive identity but contradictory container kind/count metadata can be combined and accepted as one projection. This fails the exact child-inventory/fail-closed invariant, especially for objects whose unconsumed keys are intentionally omitted.
findings.fix: Require every page to provide the same selected_kind and exact-int child_count; retain and compare these values across pages. For nested containers, require the parent descriptor child_count to be an exact int matching the child selector's reported count. Add synthetic page-drift and parent/child mismatch refusal cases.
